evidence_scope.selection: All14main +3supplement +AB06control fixed prospectively; no force fitting or post-result case selection.
evidence_scope.forward_contract: Actual forward dynamic biological tracking with physical non-impedance SEA spring/plugin, prescribed reference commands, fixed contact profile; not a rigid kinematics clamp.
evidence_scope.structural_isolation: 17AB07 models identical except distal mounting Y and selected calibrated marker locations; masses/localCOM/inertias/SEA/plugin/meshes fixed.
evidence_scope.measurement_comparison: Healthy measured GRF and virtual prosthetic hardware contact represent different physical systems; force similarity alone does not establish hardware realism.

remaining_identifiability: The donor clearance/pitch static root is conditional to its chosen targets; universal physical pylon necessity would require independent hardware floor, mounting, mass/inertia and subject measurements.
Healthy ankle center ordering is not an anatomy-only invariant; retained anatomical joint frames and own motion differ from the rigid prosthetic mechanism.
No model-anatomy-versus-total-preparation causal percentages follow from this controlled local mounting/orientation sweep.

Mean force, reserve work, tracking and closure do not by themselves prove correct contact event timing, muscle recruitment adequacy or policy transfer. Phase diagnostics are a separate bound saved-data analysis.
